```artifact
@start
mode Training
  initial state TrainingData
  transition TrainingData -> TrainingComplete when TrainingDataReady
@end

@start
mode Prediction
  initial state InitialData
  transition InitialData -> CombinedData when CombinedDataReady
  transition CombinedData -> PredictionComplete when PredictionAccuracy >= 50
@end

@start
mode Appointment
  initial state AppointmentRequest
  transition AppointmentRequest -> AppointmentConfirmation when AppointmentRequested
  transition AppointmentConfirmation -> PaymentConfirmation when PaymentRequested
  transition PaymentConfirmation -> AppointmentScheduled when PaymentCompleted
@end
```
